title: Exact accepted Source set is rejected before candidate validation
impact: The rejected subset of the pinned63 includes apps/control, internal/recoveryauthority, ops/supervisor and a numbered SQL file. The all-domain-or-backup-Go assertion is false with the shipped contract, so Root validation deterministically aborts before actual build.
required_fix: Allow exactly the reviewed full composed63 paths and validate safe repository-relative paths individually; preserve necessary SQL and non-domain components. Do not drop these pins to satisfy the predicate.

title: Success gate omits typed descendant process evidence and export
impact: The caller only passes an empty evidence directory via environment. It never reads, pins, inventories or exports its resulting native descendants evidence;13 valid-looking test2json results satisfy its success gate even when those artifacts are absent. PID/FILETIME precision, child argv/out/err and child closure cannot be audited from validation.closed.
required_fix: After native execution, validate and archive the bounded typed evidence corpus with exact refs and integer/decimal-string64 identity fields, bind it to this run and sources, check descendant closure and raw argv/stdout/stderr before producing success.

title: Cleanup aborts early and failed job closure can be reported true
impact: If the first guard returns a cleanup error, both finally loops assert before closing remaining guards. invoke can reject a result before appending to jobs; FAILED closed then reports all_owned_jobs_closed=all([])=true although the failing job has retained handles. Ready/PASS is also written before guard cleanup and validator does not require prepare cleanup refs.
required_fix: Attempt and record every guard cleanup despite errors; record job closure including exceptions/failures before rejecting a result, distinguish not-observed from closed, and publish stage-ready/success only after required cleanup is verified. Bind exact prepare cleanup/closed evidence into stage2.

title: Canonical revision gate does not validate positive integer structure
impact: Both stages accept JSON true,366.0 or0 as checkpoint revision when the numeric argument compares equal; path_ownership is hash-bound but its revision structure is never validated.
required_fix: Validate current checkpoint and ownership JSON revision as positive type-int excluding bool, then compare checkpoint with the explicit revision and bind the identical four-ref vector across stages. Keep genuine Root-provided revisions dynamic.

title: Compiler inventory omits export/cache and dependency module manifests
impact: The go list call does not request-export, and FIELDS never records pkg.Export or Module.GoMod; compilation uses shared GOCACHE/GOPATH. The Source can claim source/embed inventory but not an exact frozen compiler dependency/export closure.
required_fix: Record and guard the actual module manifests and required export/cache artifacts or use a reviewed fresh isolated cache strategy, then make the inventory claim match what is held.
